secondaryVSocket.description:
Optional secondary vSocket configuration. When provided, the site is created as a vSocket High
Availability (HA) site with a secondary socket in addition to the primary, in a single call.
Provide exactly the block matching the site's connectionType (AWS / Azure / GCP vSocket).
secondaryVSocket.name: secondaryVSocket

definition.description:
Secondary vSocket parameters supplied at site creation to build a vSocket HA site with both sockets.
Provide exactly one block, and it must correspond to the site's connectionType — supported for the
cloud vSockets only (SOCKET_AWS1500, SOCKET_AZ1500, SOCKET_GCP1500). Any other connectionType, or a
block that does not match it, is rejected.
